$comment: omapilot PLANES profile. lapis: when OMAPILOT_OVERLAY_VAULT is set it is passed as `--vault <path>` (host overlay of allowlisted live files); when UNSET no --vault is passed — never Atrium-as-overlay, no Atrium default. hedron: G5a one-tool read-only hql shim; set OMAPI_REPO to the omapi clone root (unset → literal path, server fails visible, session continues); HEDRON_DB is inherited from the omapi process environment when exported.

args: if [ -n "$OMAPILOT_OVERLAY_VAULT" ]; then exec lapis mcp --vault "$OMAPILOT_OVERLAY_VAULT"; else exec lapis mcp; fi
